rules: Do not infer DLC ownership from a PQ reward merely because the PQ requires the DLC.
Do not merge free-update DAIMA content into the paid DAIMA Pack.
Keep concrete downstream anchors navigable while preserving unresolved completeness.
Future work should replace unresolved pack-level placeholders only with concrete canonical records and source-backed evidence.
